## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete trigger and what changes for a user or operator.

## Review scope

List coupled contracts, migration/rollback needs and any deliberate exclusions.
Link the relevant architecture/runbook rather than duplicating it.

## Validation

Record exact commands/results and distinguish local tests, provider mocks,
viewport emulation and live acceptance. Include screenshots for visible changes.

## Deployment impact

State environment/schema/provider changes, cost impact, and whether the change
is deployed. Do not equate passing CI with reconstruction quality or launch approval.
